stories.title: Explainability Schema Definition (Pydantic Models)
stories.description: Define a standardized explainability schema using Pydantic models including fields for source, meaning, and limitations, ensuring compatibility across provider and clinical trial signals.

stories.title: Explainability Builder Logic
stories.description: Implement core backend logic to construct explainability objects from raw signals (NPI data, external links, clinical trial attributes), mapping each signal to source, meaning, and limitations.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Metadata
stories.description: Extend MessageBubble component to display explainability metadata (source, meaning, limitations) in a structured and readable format within chat responses.

stories.title: Explainability Fallback Handling
stories.description: Implement fallback logic to handle missing or incomplete explainability fields, ensuring the system always returns safe, user-understandable defaults without breaking schema contract.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Explainability Builder Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating that explainability builder correctly maps raw evaluation signals into schema-compliant explainability objects across providers and clinical trials.
